input.query: SELECT a.month, COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.is_active) AS active_users, SUM(a.card_spend_eur) AS spend, SUM(a.card_spend_eur)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.is_active),0) AS spend_per_active, SUM(a.n_card_txns)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) FILTER (WHERE a.is_active),0) AS txns_per_active, SUM(a.n_card_txns) AS txns FROM fct_activity_monthly a JOIN dim_users u USING(user_id) WHERE u.country='RO' AND a.month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND a.month < DATE '2026-06-01' GROUP BY a.month ORDER BY a.month
